'''Leo''' is a boy NPC located at [[Fool's Elysium]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(First interaction with Cratos and [[Marianne]])
:'''Leo:''' Wow! Cool! Let me listen!
:'''Cratos:''' Leo! No! Good children shouldn't learn that! Ugh, I'll need to figure out how to separate it from the rest of the Fae Ignises...
:{{DIcon}} What happened?
:'''Marianne:''' Well, this Fae Ignis somehow picked up some foul language, and it just can't stop using it.
:'''Angry Fae Ignis:''' *Ragunna curse* the Order! You're a *Ragunna curse* coward! Coward! Liar! Liar!
:'''Marianne:''' See? Just like that.
:'''Angry Fae Ignis:''' Coward! Coward! Coward!
:'''Marianne:''' I really don't know where it learned that. Could it be that these words were the reason the Order banished it?
:'''Angry Fae Ignis:''' The Order! Liar! Liar! Liar!
----
;(When stading alone under a lamp)
:'''Leo:''' Hey, let me tell you a little secret...
:{{DIcon}} What secret?
:'''Leo:''' Yesterday, Leo overheard Pan Cake whispering with all the Fae Ignises in the troupe, and Marianne's Fae Ignis joined in too!
:'''Leo:''' Pan Cake taught them that! In fact, all the Fae Ignises in the troupe have picked it up now.
----
;{{Spoiler}}
;(First interaction after {{Quest|Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides}})
:'''Angry Fae Ignis:''' People of Ragunna! Confront the Dark Tide and protect our people! Give it your all for Ragunna! Protect the Dark Tide!
:'''Leo:''' No, no, that's not how it goes. It's "Confront the Dark Tide and protect our people." 
:'''Cratos:''' Leo, you too? Now you're trying to teach it as well?
:'''Cratos:''' Sigh... Well, I suppose that's still better than what it said before.
:'''Marianne:''' Leo, are you done? I want to teach it something else next...
{{Dialogue End}}
